"""Find the stretches of opening hours that no one is covering."""

import hourglass.parsing
import hourglass.models
import hourglass.merging


# ---
def uncovered_gaps(worked, opening):
    """One label such as 'gap 12:00-13:00 (60 min)' per uncovered stretch.

    Raises ValueError when a worked span falls outside the opening hours.
    """
    spans = list(worked)
    for span in spans:
        if span.start < opening.start or span.end > opening.end:
            raise ValueError(
                f"{hourglass.parsing.format_span(span)} is outside opening hours"
            )

    labels = []
    cursor = opening.start
    for span in hourglass.merging.merge_spans(spans):
        if span.start > cursor:
            labels.append(_gap_label(cursor, span.start))
        cursor = span.end
    if cursor < opening.end:
        labels.append(_gap_label(cursor, opening.end))
    return labels


def _gap_label(start, end):
    gap = hourglass.models.Span(start, end)
    return f"gap {hourglass.parsing.format_span(gap)} ({gap.minutes} min)"
EOF
cat > tests/test_gaps.py <<'EOF'
import unittest

import hourglass.parsing
import hourglass.gaps


def spans(*texts):
    return [hourglass.parsing.parse_span(text) for text in texts]


class GapTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_gap_between_spans(self):
        opening = hourglass.parsing.parse_span("09:00-17:00")
        result = hourglass.gaps.uncovered_gaps(
            spans("09:00-12:00", "13:00-17:00"), opening
        )
        self.assertEqual(result, ["gap 12:00-13:00 (60 min)"])

    def test_edges_and_overlaps(self):
        opening = hourglass.parsing.parse_span("09:00-17:00")
        result = hourglass.gaps.uncovered_gaps(
            spans("10:00-12:00", "11:00-13:00"), opening
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            result, ["gap 09:00-10:00 (60 min)", "gap 13:00-17:00 (240 min)"]
        )

    def test_no_gaps_when_fully_covered(self):
        opening = hourglass.parsing.parse_span("09:00-17:00")
        result = hourglass.gaps.uncovered_gaps(spans("09:00-17:00"), opening)
        self.assertEqual(result, [])

    def test_nobody_working_is_one_gap(self):
        opening = hourglass.parsing.parse_span("09:00-10:00")
        result = hourglass.gaps.uncovered_gaps([], opening)
        self.assertEqual(result, ["gap 09:00-10:00 (60 min)"])

    def test_span_outside_opening_hours_raises(self):
        opening = hourglass.parsing.parse_span("09:00-17:00")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            hourglass.gaps.uncovered_gaps(spans("08:00-10:00"), opening)
EOF
